title: RadiationEvent
description: Schema for events on radiation.raw and radiation.clean Kafka topics

sensor_id.description: Unique identifier for the sensor/device (Device ID from Safecast CSV)

captured_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp when the measurement was captured (event time)

uploaded_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp when the measurement was uploaded to Safecast (processing time, used for ordering)

cpm.description: Counts per minute radiation measurement. Null if sensor malfunction or missing.

classification.description: Threshold classification assigned by Flink. Null on radiation.raw, populated on radiation.clean.

sensor_type.description: Producer mobility heuristic: 'fixed' if the sensor's readings stay within a small radius, 'mobile' once they range beyond it. Null if not yet determined. See ADR-011.

height.description: Height of the sensor above ground in metres, if available

md5sum.description: MD5 checksum of the original CSV row for deduplication
